The '''2016–17 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team''' represented [[West Virginia University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mountaineers were coached by [[Bob Huggins]], in his 10th season as WVU's head coach, and played their home games at [[WVU Coliseum]] in [[Morgantown, West Virginia]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–9, 12–6 in [[2016–17 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for second place. They defeated [[2016–17 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] and [[2016–17 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the [[2017 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] before losing to [[2016–17 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Bucknell Bison men's basketball team|Bucknell]] and [[2016–17 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] before losing in the Sweet Sixteen to [[2016–17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]].

==Previous season==
The [[2015–16 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|Mountaineers]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 26–9, 13–5 in [[2015–16 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in second place in conference. They defeated [[2015–16 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] and [[2015–16 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2016 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2015–16 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where, as a No. 3 seed, they were upset in the First Round by No. 14 seed [[2015–16 Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks basketball team|Stephen F. Austin]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2016/03/18/stephen-f-austin-shocks-west-virginia-ncaa-tournament-cinderella-thomas-walkup/82000398/|title=Another upset: No. 14 Stephen F. Austin shocks West Virginia|first=Nicole|last=Auerbach|work=[[USA Today]]|date=March 18, 2016|access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref>
